items.source: context - the evaluation context in which the access is being attempted
items.translation: context - 尝试访问时的评估上下文

items.source: target - the target object upon which the property is being accessed
items.translation: target - 正在访问属性的目标对象

items.source: name - the name of the property being accessed
items.translation: name - 正在访问的属性的名称

items.source: The general ReflectivePropertyAccessor will always work but is not optimal due to the need to look up which reflective member (method or field) to use each time read(EvaluationContext, Object, String) is called.
items.translation: 通用的 `ReflectivePropertyAccessor` 始终有效，但由于每次调用 `read(EvaluationContext, Object, String)` 时都需要查找要使用的反射成员（方法或字段），因此并非最优选择。

items.source: This method will return this ReflectivePropertyAccessor instance if it is unable to build an optimized accessor.
items.translation: 此方法将在无法构建优化访问器时返回该 `ReflectivePropertyAccessor` 实例。

items.source:
A property can be referenced through a public getter method (when being read)
or a public setter method (when being written), and also through a public field.
items.translation: 属性可以通过公共 getter 方法（读取时）或公共 setter 方法（写入时）引用，也可以通过公共字段引用。

items.source:
Note: An optimized accessor is currently only usable for read attempts.
Do not call this method if you need a read-write accessor.
items.translation: 注意：优化的访问器当前仅可用于读取操作。如果您需要读写访问器，请勿调用此方法。

items.source: Returns null which means this is a general purpose accessor.
items.translation: 返回null，表示这是一个通用访问器。

items.source: Create a new property accessor for reading as well as writing.
items.translation: 创建一个新的属性访问器，用于读取和写入。

items.source: Create a new property accessor for reading and possibly also writing.
items.translation: 创建一个新的属性访问器用于读取，可能也用于写入。

items.source:
Called to determine if this property accessor is able to read a specified
property on a specified target object.
items.translation: 调用以确定此属性访问器是否能够在指定的目标对象上读取指定的属性。

items.source:
Called to determine if this property accessor is able to write to a specified
property on a specified target object.
items.translation: 调用以确定此属性访问器是否能够在指定的目标对象上向指定的属性写入数据。

items.source: Find a field of a certain name on a specified class.
items.translation: 在指定的类中查找具有特定名称的字段。

items.source: Find a getter method for the specified property.
items.translation: 查找指定属性的 getter 方法。

items.source: Find a setter method for the specified property.
items.translation: 查找指定属性的 setter 方法。

items.source:
Return the method suffixes for a given property name. The default implementation
uses JavaBean conventions with additional support for properties of the form 'xY'
where the method 'getXY()' is used in preference to the JavaBean convention of
'getxY()'.
items.translation: 返回给定属性名的方法后缀。默认实现遵循 JavaBean 约定，并额外支持形式为 'xY' 的属性，其中使用 `getXY()` 方法优先于 JavaBean 约定的 `getxY()`。

items.source:
Return the method suffix for a given property name. The default implementation
uses JavaBean conventions.
items.translation: 返回给定属性名的方法后缀。默认实现遵循 JavaBean 约定。

items.source: Andy Clement, Juergen Hoeller, Phillip Webb, Sam Brannen, Sebastien Deleuze
items.translation: Andy Clement, Juergen Hoeller, Phillip Webb, Sam Brannen, Sebastien Deleuze

items.source: Should only succeed if PropertyAccessor.canRead(EvaluationContext, Object, String) also returns true.
items.translation: 仅当 `PropertyAccessor.canRead(EvaluationContext, Object, String)` 也返回 `true` 时才应成功。

items.source: Should only succeed if PropertyAccessor.canWrite(EvaluationContext, Object, String) also returns true.
items.translation: 仅当 `PropertyAccessor.canWrite(EvaluationContext, Object, String)` 也返回 `true` 时才应成功。

items.source: The default implementation considers any method as a candidate, even for non-user-declared properties on the Object base class.
items.translation: 默认实现会将任何方法都视为候选项，即使这些方法属于 Object 基类中非用户声明的属性。

items.translation: 尝试为特定类上的具有特定名称的属性创建优化的属性访问器。

items.translation: AccessException - 如果确定是否可以读取该属性时出现任何问题

items.translation: AccessException - 如果读取属性值时出现任何问题

items.translation: AccessException - 如果确定是否可以写入该属性时出现任何问题

items.translation: allowWrite - 是否允许对目标实例执行写入操作

items.translation: 一个此访问器适用的类数组（或如果是通用访问器则为 `null` 或空数组）

items.translation: newValue - 该属性的新值
